test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: According to the passage, what is one major obstacle to ensuring fairness and accountability in Al systems?

options.text: The high cost of building Al models.
The limited availability of data scientists.
The inability to fully explain how Al systems reach conclusions.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights the **"black box" problem** in AI systems.
 
• This refers to the **inability to fully explain how AI systems reach their conclusions**, even by developers.
 
• Such opacity makes it difficult to ensure **fairness, accountability, and transparency**.
 
• Hence, the major obstacle is clearly connected to the **lack of explainability** in AI systems.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "The high cost of building AI models"** – Not mentioned as the central problem in the passage.
 
• **Option 2: "The limited availability of data scientists"** – The passage does not discuss this issue.
 
• **Option 4: "The lack of government funding"** – No reference is made to funding as the obstacle.
